# WingFoil template catalog

> The official WingFoil template packs, indexed for agents: anonymous raw URLs, each published
> version pinned to its tag.

## Index

- [catalog-index.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wingfoil/wingfoil-templates/main/catalog-index.json): every published pack, preset and transition (format 1); search is a local filter over it
- [CATALOG.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wingfoil/wingfoil-templates/main/CATALOG.md): the same index for people

## Specifications

- [spec-001](https://github.com/wingfoil/wingfoil-templates/blob/main/docs/memory/tech-spec/spec-001-the-pack-format-manifest-fragments-composition-catalog-compatibility-and-digest.md): the pack format
- [spec-002](https://github.com/wingfoil/wingfoil-templates/blob/main/docs/memory/tech-spec/spec-002-pack-readme-and-catalog-index.md): the pack README and the catalog index

## Reading a pack

- the index: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wingfoil/wingfoil-templates/main/catalog-index.json`
- a published version's README: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wingfoil/wingfoil-templates/refs/tags/<catalog pack id>@<version>/packs/<catalog pack id>/README.md`
- a published version's manifest: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wingfoil/wingfoil-templates/refs/tags/<catalog pack id>@<version>/packs/<catalog pack id>/pack.yaml`
- resolution: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wingfoil/wingfoil-templates/main/catalog.yaml`
- compatibility: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wingfoil/wingfoil-templates/main/compat.yaml`
- a preset: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wingfoil/wingfoil-templates/main/presets/<id>.yaml`
- a transition: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wingfoil/wingfoil-templates/main/transitions/<id>.yaml`
